name: GIRLDREAMS
source:
you are not yourself

though you don't notice, at first

because who is you

when you are asleep?

[From [url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/girldreams]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你已不再是你自己

尽管起初你并未察觉

毕竟当你沉睡之时

那个“你”究竟是谁？

[摘自[url=https://jammyjams.itch.io/girldreams]itch.io[/url]]
